# banner (yellow style)

The YouTube banner. Upload the 2560 x 1440 PNG (each is under 6 MB). A = name and supporting line, B = logo only, C = wordmark only, D = the dark alternate. The `master` files are 5120 x 2880 for editing. The safe-area guide shows the 1546 x 423 area that every device shows; the device previews show how each banner crops.
